description: Executable-section inventory and include/exclude policy for the Burnout lift. Generated by tools/section-inventory.py from the parser output; do not hand-edit -- edit RATIONALE in that tool and regenerate.
source_analysis_note: Regenerated by regenerate.sh stage 0 from the verified XBE; the identical file also exists as a Phase 0 research artifact.
selection_rule: swept <=> executable flag AND raw_size > 0 AND name not in DATA_SECTION_NAMES; mirrors xboxrecomp-fork/tools/disasm/loader.py
extra_sections_note: Empty: every section believed to hold Burnout code is already swept by the default (non --text-only) run, so --extra-sections is not needed. The Breakdown control needs --extra-sections DSOUND only because its DSOUND section is not marked executable; Burnout's is. Do NOT pass --text-only: it would drop six XDK sections including DSOUND and XPP.

sections.name: .text
sections.rationale: Criterion game code. The baseline; always swept.

sections.name: D3D
sections.rationale: Statically linked Xbox D3D8 4361. Swept by default. Real code, reached through the game's render calls.

sections.name: D3DX
sections.rationale: Statically linked D3DX8 4361 helpers. Swept by default.

sections.name: XGRPH
sections.rationale: Statically linked XGRAPHC 4361. Swept by default.

sections.name: DSOUND
sections.rationale: Statically linked DirectSound 4361. Swept by default. On the Breakdown control this section held vtable-dispatched audio methods reachable ONLY as data -- expect Burnout to need seeds here too (phase 2+).

sections.name: XPP
sections.rationale: Xbox XPP support code. Swept by default; held real seeded functions on the Breakdown control.

sections.name: .rdata
sections.rationale: Marked executable by the linker but is read-only data, and disassembles happily into nonsense. Excluded by name in loader.py. Never override.

sections.name: .data
sections.rationale: Marked executable and writable; 7.1 MiB of it is zero-fill, which decodes as 'add [eax], al' and yields phantom functions. Excluded by name in loader.py. Never override.

sections.name: DOLBY
sections.rationale: Marked executable and swept by default, but on the Breakdown control the equivalent section holds the audio DSP's firmware image, not x86. Burnout also ships an opaque dsstdfx.bin. Treat any function reported here as suspect until a caller is demonstrated; do NOT hand-seed into it. The disassembler's own guard (a section counts as code only once a stronger pass finds a function in it) is the first line of defence.

sections.name: $$XTIMAGE
sections.rationale: Non-executable insert section (title image). Not code.

sections.name: $$XSIMAGE
sections.rationale: Non-executable insert section (saved-game image). Not code.
